intervals: Paired question bootstrap and joint seed/question bootstrap; resample same question identities jointly across seeds/methods; Bonferroni familywise intervals for seven contrasts, alongside unadjusted95%.
success_description: Report all seed results; call a stable gain only if all three seed differences are positive and joint seed/question familywise lower bound is positive. Three seeds still provide limited pipeline uncertainty and share data/target generation.
noninferiority: Not tested; failure to find difference is not equivalence.
